# evroc_service_account (Data Source)

Retrieves information about an existing evroc IAM service account.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the service account to look up.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the service account was created (RFC3339 format).
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the service account's purpose.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the service account is enabled.
- `fqid` (String) Fully qualified identifier for the service account.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `oauth_client_id` (String) OAuth client ID assigned to the service account.
- `project` (String) Project this service account belongs to.
- `service_account_id` (String) System-assigned unique identifier (UUID) of the service account.
- `user_labels` (Map of String) User-defined labels attached to the service account.
